A score of 1.40 (Router's base) was too harsh for an image where only the distal limbs are affected while the primary subject identity is clear. I am adjusting the authenticity score upward to reflect that the defect is localized to the paws/hocks rather than systemic, but keeping it below 3.0 due to the visible anatomical ambiguity.
